metadata.author: V2 expansion (subagent draft)
metadata.key_test: Safeguard A (externally imposed statebuilding): do imposed institutions with low organic legitimacy -- the Coalition Provisional Authority handover plus the muhassasa sectarian-quota system -- predict recurrent violence regardless of formal P1 inputs? Tests whether external administration + sectarian-quota design drive the 2006-2008 civil war and 2014 ISIS collapse.
metadata.notes: Reference-based record: indicators resolved live via mi.datasource. Entity includes the Coalition Provisional Authority context. resolved_scores carry MI v2 re-scored pillars (pre 2004, post 2024).

pre_event.event_description: Iraq at the 2004 CPA-to-sovereignty handover -- a state being rebuilt under external administration on an imposed sectarian-quota (muhassasa) settlement, with a floor-level institutional and cohesion base.

context.admin_details: Coalition Provisional Authority (CPA, 2003-2004) governed Iraq and designed the post-Saddam settlement; externally imposed muhassasa sectarian-quota power-sharing handed to a sovereign Iraqi government in June 2004.
context.backstop_details: US-led coalition military presence underwrote the state through 2011 (and again post-2014 vs ISIS).
context.neighbor_details: Iran influence + Syria war spillover (ISIS cross-border).

Iraq.notes: Indicators resolved via mi.datasource (Iraq, 2004 -> 2024). Floor-level pre-event base (P1 0.254, P5 0.173) under external administration; the case probes Safeguard A and whether imposed institutions predict recurrent violence.

a_trajectory_ranking.prediction: Bottom-tier (Tier 4) with high instability; at best a slow, fragile climb off the floor.
a_trajectory_ranking.basis: Pre-P1 0.254 (bottom) and P5 cohesion 0.173 (floor) under imposed institutions; predicts persistent instability.
a_trajectory_ranking.falsification_condition: Iraq stabilizes into a high tier without major violence.

b_violence.prediction: Critical political-violence risk; recurrent civil conflict.
b_violence.agency_note: Mod8: this predicts RISK, not AGENCY.

c_convergence.prediction: N/A (single entity); self-trajectory off a floor.

d_failure_dimension.prediction: Primary failure on P1 (imposed institutions, low organic legitimacy) compounded by P5 sectarian-cohesion floor.
d_failure_dimension.note: Most exposed to post-hoc coding bias.
d_failure_dimension.falsification_condition: Failure concentrates on a non-institutional/non-cohesion dimension.

e_fragment_count.prediction: High fragmentation risk: de facto Kurdish (KRG) autonomy and an ISIS proto-state, but no formal successor states (Iraq stays nominally intact, n_successor_states 0).
e_fragment_count.falsification_condition: Either permanent formal partition OR no fragmentation pressure at all.

f_reversal_risk.prediction: Elevated reversal/legitimacy risk of the imposed institutions (externally underwritten, organically weak).
f_reversal_risk.falsification_condition: Imposed institutions consolidate organic legitimacy quickly without reversal.

g_suppression_mechanism.classification: N/A -- post-Saddam reconstruction; not a suppression-tier suppressed-fragmentation case at the 2004 baseline.

h_substate_turbulence.prediction: Severe sub-state turbulence triggered: sectarian militias (Mahdi Army, later PMF/Hashd), Kurdish Peshmerga, ISIS.
h_substate_turbulence.falsification_condition: No armed sub-state actors / no sub-state turbulence.

Iraq.outcome_summary: P1 0.254->0.320; MI 0.371->0.447 (Tier 4 -> Tier 3, a fragile climb off the floor on oil-driven capacity). Imposed sectarian-quota institutions produced recurrent violence: 2006-2008 sectarian civil war (tens of thousands dead), 2014 ISIS seizure of ~one-third of the country, 2014-2017 war to retake it; 2017 Kurdish independence referendum and de facto KRG autonomy, but Iraq stayed formally intact. P5 cohesion 0.173->0.272; P4 capacity 0.293->0.590 (oil).
key_events: 2017 Kurdish independence referendum / de facto KRG autonomy

a_trajectory.evidence: Pre Tier 4 (MI 0.371) with floor P1 0.254 / P5 0.173; high instability throughout; only a fragile climb to Tier 3 by 2024.
a_trajectory.explanation: Bottom-tier instability as predicted; the post climb is oil-capacity-driven, not institutional consolidation.

b_violence.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28: focus=Iraq pre-P1=0.254 -> HIGH risk (MI v1, anchored)

d_failure_dimension.evidence: P5 cohesion stayed at the floor (0.173->0.272) and P1 remained bottom-band amid imposed institutions; violence recurred regardless of formal inputs.
d_failure_dimension.explanation: Institutional-legitimacy + sectarian-cohesion failure as predicted; post-hoc dimension call coded PARTIAL.
d_failure_dimension.computed_config: Iraq: P3=0.57, P2=0.56, P4=0.29, P1=0.25, P5=0.17 | below-median (genuine vulnerabilities): P5=0.17, P1=0.25, P4=0.29

e_fragment_count.evidence: De facto KRG autonomy + 2017 referendum and an ISIS proto-state, yet Iraq stayed formally intact (no successor states).
e_fragment_count.explanation: High fragmentation pressure without formal partition, exactly as predicted; Safeguard B applied.
e_fragment_count.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28 (outcome judgment preserved; safeguard re-evaluated on real data)

f_reversal_risk.evidence: Imposed institutions repeatedly failed (2014 collapse) and remained externally underwritten; low organic legitimacy.
f_reversal_risk.explanation: Reversal/legitimacy risk of imposed institutions realized.
f_reversal_risk.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28 (outcome judgment preserved; safeguard re-evaluated on real data)

g_suppression.explanation: Not a suppression-tier case at the 2004 reconstruction baseline.
g_suppression.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28 (outcome judgment preserved; safeguard re-evaluated on real data)

h_turbulence.evidence: Mahdi Army / PMF (Hashd) militias, Kurdish Peshmerga, and ISIS all operated as armed sub-state actors.
h_turbulence.explanation: Severe sub-state turbulence triggered as predicted.
h_turbulence.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28 (outcome judgment preserved; safeguard re-evaluated on real data)

analysis.overall_assessment: Confirms the externally-imposed-statebuilding thesis: CPA-handover + muhassasa sectarian-quota institutions with low organic legitimacy predicted recurrent violence and chronic fragmentation pressure regardless of formal inputs.
new_failure_modes_discovered: Oil-driven P4 capacity gains can lift the composite MI (Tier 4 -> Tier 3) while the institutional/cohesion core stays at the floor -- a reconstruction 'capacity flatters legitimacy' trap.
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: Imposed institutions plus a sectarian-quota settlement under external administration generate recurrent violence and fragmentation pressure that formal P1/MI inputs understate until organic legitimacy develops.
proposed_framework_modifications: When Safeguard A is active, flag composite-MI gains driven by resource-rent P4 as not evidencing institutional consolidation.
analysis.baseline_impact: Proposed flag is additive; not yet implemented; baseline unchanged.
analysis.phase3_note: Migrated to MI v1 + Data API references. a_trajectory/c_convergence auto-derived from real re-scored data (Mod4-gated); b/d/e/f/g/h preserved as judgment.
analysis.judgment_refresh_note: Judgment verdicts (b/d/e/f/g/h) re-examined against MI v1 real-data scores on 2026-06-28: no verdict flips (directional readings robust to the legacy->anchored vintage change); b risk-levels refreshed from real pre-P1, d augmented with the real config (weakest pillar flagged as a binding vulnerability only when below median), safeguards re-evaluated.
